About the Role

We are looking for a practical, hands-on AI Prompt Engineer who enjoys building real AI-powered applicationsnot just experimenting with prompts. This role involves working closely with developers and product teams to design prompts, connect them to applications, test AI outputs, and deploy working AI tools. If you enjoy using modern AI and developer tools to build useful products, this role will suit you well.
What You Do (Day-to-Day)
1. Prompt Design & AI Interaction

Write, test, and improve prompts for AI features such as chat, automation, and internal tools.

Fine-tune AI responses to make them accurate, clear, and reliable.

Experiment with different prompt styles based on project needs.
2. AI Application Support

Help integrate AI prompts into web or internal applications.

Work with developers to connect AI logic with APIs and workflows.

Assist in building task-based AI flows and simple AI agents.
3. Testing, Debugging & Improvements

Test AI outputs and identify issues like wrong answers or inconsistencies.

Improve prompt performance through iteration and feedback.

Ensure AI features work smoothly in real-world usage.
4. Basic Deployment & Setup Support

Support hosting and deployment of AI applications.

Help with setting up and managing cloud-based components such as databases and storage.

Assist in maintaining project repositories and deployments.
5. Documentation & Collaboration

Maintain simple documentation for prompts and AI workflows.
